title: Planned 2020 Summit: archived presentation voting
body:
How the former voting interface worked

Community voting helped inform which proposed presentations would be included in a Summit schedule. The interface offered four choices: “Would Love To See!”, “Would Try To See”, “Might See” and “Would Not See”.

Voting is closed. This archive does not display proposals, individual votes or voting results.

This is an archive of the planned 2020 event workflow; it does not imply that the event took place.

Browse the Planned 2020 Summit archive
